items.title: Show HN: Debut – Replace macOS Cmd-Tab with a per-Space window switcher
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I built Debut because macOS Cmd-Tab doesn't work well with Spaces. When an app has windows on several Spaces, Cmd-Tab treats them as one app, so it's hard to get to a specific window.
Debut changes Cmd-Tab to show only the windows on the current Space. It also shows all Spaces and their windows in one view, where you can add/remove/reorder Spaces and move windows between them.
